name: SendGrid
tagline: Email delivery API for transactional and marketing messages
description: SendGrid is Twilio’s email platform API for sending transactional and marketing email at scale. Developers authenticate with API keys, use a REST API (and SMTP) to send mail, manage contacts/templates, and track delivery events via webhooks. Widely used for app notifications, password resets, and bulk campaigns.

auth.details: API key via Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY header; keys created in SendGrid dashboard (Settings → API Keys).

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free plan historically allowed limited daily email sends; verify current Twilio SendGrid pricing for exact free-tier volume.
pricing.paid_plans: Essentials, Pro, Premier, and Marketing Campaigns plans billed by email volume; see Twilio SendGrid pricing.

rate_limits: Varies by endpoint and plan; many mail-send endpoints document rate limits in response headers (X-RateLimit-*). Check docs for per-endpoint limits.

example.request: curl -X POST "https://api.sendgrid.com/v3/mail/send" -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"personalizations":[{"to":[{"email":"recipient@example.com"}]}],"from":{"email":"sender@example.com"},"subject":"Hello","content":[{"type":"text/plain","value":"Hello from SendGrid"}]}'
example.response_snippet: HTTP 202 Accepted (empty body on success for mail/send); errors return JSON like {"errors":[{"message":"...","field":null,"help":null}]}

use_cases: track bounces, opens, and clicks via event webhook
manage contact lists and suppression groups
